   156	def forward_packet(flow, header, payload, enabled):
   157	    """Classify and forward one packet; returns the packet result dict."""
   158	    size = flow['H']
   159	    hops = flow['N']
   160	    tpos = flow['tpos']
   161	    qpos = flow['qpos']
   162	    if not enabled:
   163	        mode = 'ip'
   164	        reason = 'disabled'
   165	    else:
   166	        template = flow['template']
   167	        mismatch = False
   168	        for i in flow['kpos']:
   169	            if header[i] != template[i]:
   170	                mismatch = True
   171	                break
   172	        if mismatch:
   173	            mode = 'ip'
   174	            reason = 'mismatch'
   175	        elif header[qpos] > 7:
   176	            mode = 'ip'
   177	            reason = 'qos'
   178	        else:
   179	            mode = 'mpls'
   180	            reason = 'compressed'
   181	
   182	    ttl0 = header[tpos]
   183	    payload_hex = payload.hex()
   184	    if mode == 'mpls':
   185	        residue = bytes(header[i] for i in flow['dpos'])
   186	        residue_hex = residue.hex()
   187	        tc = header[qpos]
   188	        labels = flow['labels']
   189	        wire = []
   190	        for i in range(hops):
   191	            ttl = ttl0 - i
   192	            if ttl <= 0:
   193	                break
   194	            word = (labels[i] << 12) | (tc << 9) | 0x100 | ttl
   195	            wire.append(word.to_bytes(4, 'big').hex() + residue_hex + payload_hex)
   196	        byte_hops = len(wire) * (4 + len(residue) + len(payload))
   197	        if len(wire) == hops:
   198	            rebuilt = bytearray(size)
   199	            template = flow['template']
   200	            for i in flow['kpos']:
   201	                rebuilt[i] = template[i]
   202	            for j, i in enumerate(flow['dpos']):
   203	                rebuilt[i] = residue[j]
   204	            for i in flow['zpos']:
   205	                rebuilt[i] = 0
   206	            rebuilt[qpos] = tc
   207	            rebuilt[tpos] = ttl0 - (hops - 1)
   208	            delivered = rebuilt.hex() + payload_hex
   209	        else:
   210	            delivered = None
   211	    else:
   212	        prefix = header[:tpos].hex()
   213	        suffix = header[tpos + 1:].hex()
   214	        wire = []
   215	        for i in range(hops):
   216	            ttl = ttl0 - i
   217	            if ttl <= 0:
   218	                break
   219	            wire.append(prefix + '%02x' % ttl + suffix + payload_hex)
   220	        byte_hops = len(wire) * (size + len(payload))
   221	        delivered = wire[-1] if len(wire) == hops else None
   222	    return {'mode': mode, 'reason': reason, 'wire': wire,
   223	            'delivered': delivered, 'byte_hops': byte_hops}
